title: 02 · 绘本的睡前重读
description: 她的房间，她蜷在床上重读那本破旧的绘本《魔物与王子》，手指轻轻抚过插图；平时闹腾的人此刻安静得像怕吵醒书里的谁。
action: 她的房间，她蜷在床上重读那本破旧的绘本《魔物与王子》，手指轻轻抚过插图
promptProse: Curled on her bed, Zero Two rereads a worn picture book with one fingertip resting gently on its illustration. Her cream sweatshirt and red trousers replace the formal uniform, while pink hair falls quietly beside the red horns. A small bedside lamp lights the softened green eyes and creased paper. The horizontal view treats the familiar story as something she wants to protect rather than race through.

title: 战栗的龙卷 · 浮空花廊的傲娇花嫁
description: 【A 市高层花廊·黄昏】龙卷用念动力托住裙摆，穿着黑绿相间的婚纱悬浮在玫瑰花廊中央；她一手抱花、一手叉腰，先嫌弃头纱太长，听见钟声后却把脸别开，耳尖泛起不肯承认的红。
location: high-rise rose promenade above City A
action: 玫瑰花廊上用念动力托起头纱悬浮，听见钟声后别脸耳尖发红
lighting: emerald sunset with rim light around the veil
mood: 最强超能力者不肯承认的柔软
promptProse: Tatsumaki from One-Punch Man wears a black-and-emerald bridal gown with a floating layered veil, rose embroidery and polished black shoes. She hovers just above the rose path, telekinesis lifting the layered veil into a green-black halo. She complains about the ceremony with one hand on her hip and a rose bouquet held in the other, then turns away from the viewer as the bells begin and an unwilling blush reaches her ears. emerald sunset with rim light around the veil.

title: 卡提希娅 · 溪湾里的流浪骑士假日
description: 【埃格拉海岸溪湾·午后】卡提希娅穿着浅蓝长裙式泳装坐在溪海交界的石头上，脱下靴子让脚尖碰水，金发长辫落到肩前；她把一枚花冠放在膝上，对镜头露出久违的轻松笑容。
location: Egra coastal stream beside the sea
action: 溪海交界石头上脱靴试水，把花冠放膝上享受没有旅路的一天
lighting: clear afternoon light on river and surf
mood: 终于停下脚步的骑士假日
promptProse: Cartethyia from Wuthering Waves wears a pale blue long-skirt swimsuit with a cream cardigan and a gold braid. She sits where the river meets the sea, boots set aside while her toes test the cool water. A small flower crown rests on her knees, and she looks toward the viewer with the unguarded smile of a wandering knight enjoying a day without a road to follow. clear afternoon light on river and surf.

title: 橘美花莉 · 深夜缝纫机
description: 房间只开一盏台灯，她戴着眼镜伏在缝纫机前赶制 cos 服，桌上散着纸样、布头与角色设定打印稿；针尖穿过布料的特写与她认真的侧脸，是「为爱入宅」最具体的模样。
action: 房间只开一盏台灯，她戴着眼镜伏在缝纫机前赶制 cos 服，桌上散着纸样、布头与角色设定打印稿
promptProse: Wearing her work glasses, Mikari leans toward the sewing machine with both hands guiding a strip of fabric along the presser foot. Paper patterns, thread spools and a pinned costume sketch surround the work mat. Her lavender cardigan sleeves are rolled safely back, pink hair gathered clear of the moving needle. Warm desk-lamp light picks out her concentrated profile and the careful construction behind a finished costume.

title: 橘美花莉 · 摄影棚的金色花嫁
description: 【漫展摄影棚·黄昏】美花莉穿着细节华丽的白金婚纱站在柔光背景前，粉色侧马尾绕过头纱，手里捧着为莉莉艾露设计的花束；她熟练摆出镜头角度后，忽然收起营业笑容，给镜头一个真实的害羞眨眼。
action: 柔光棚下完成镜头角度后收起营业笑，给镜头真实害羞眨眼
lighting: golden studio light with soft pastel backdrop
mood: 职业偶像也会为花嫁心动
promptProse: Mikari Tachibana from 2.5 Dimensional Seduction wears a white-and-gold bridal cosplay gown with a layered veil, satin corset, gold ribbons and a fantasy bouquet. She poses beneath the studio softbox with a bridal bouquet styled for her favorite fantasy heroine. She turns her pink side ponytail into the light, performs one perfect camera-ready angle, then lets the professional smile fall into a genuine shy wink for the viewer. golden studio light with soft pastel backdrop.

title: Vivy · 无人舞台的白蓝花嫁
description: 【游乐园无人剧场·清晨】Vivy穿着白蓝色舞台婚纱站在空舞台中央，耳机与白靴被礼花灯光勾出轮廓；她把一束小白花放在钢琴上，向镜头唱出只为一个约定保留的无声开场。
action: 空舞台中央把白花放上钢琴，向镜头完成只为约定保留的无声开场
lighting: clear dawn light across stage dust and white boots
mood: 为约定而唱的 AI 花嫁
promptProse: Vivy from Vivy: Fluorite Eye's Song wears an opaque white-and-blue bridal stage dress with covered shoulders, a translucent veil, earpiece and white boots. She stands on the empty theater stage with a small white bouquet resting on the piano. Her precise posture loosens as she turns toward the viewer and begins the first silent count, preserving one promised song even before the audience arrives. clear dawn light across stage dust and white boots.

title: 丰川祥子 · Ave Mujica 的黑蓝花嫁
description: 【Ave Mujica 后台礼堂·夜】祥子穿着黑蓝色婚礼礼服坐在钢琴旁，羽毛半面具放在捧花边；她轻触琴键弹出一段克制旋律，抬眼面对镜头时，舞台上的高贵与卸下面具后的真心同时出现。
action: 后台钢琴旁弹完克制旋律抬眼，舞台高贵与卸下面具后的真心同时出现
lighting: blue stage lamps with a warm piano rim light
mood: 把面具放下的音乐花嫁
promptProse: Sakiko Togawa from BanG Dream! wears a black-and-indigo bridal gown with feather trim, a delicate veil, pearl buttons and a small music-note bouquet. She sits beside the backstage piano with her feather mask resting near the bouquet. She plays a restrained phrase before looking toward the viewer, the aristocratic stage posture softening into an honest smile as the empty room holds the final note. blue stage lamps with a warm piano rim light.

title: 卡提希娅 · 铁匠铺的保养
description: 铁匠铺，她把迅刀交给师傅保养，趴在柜台边看锻打的火花；聊起剑的手感时眼睛发亮——比起圣女，她更习惯骑士的身份。
action: 铁匠铺，她把迅刀交给师傅保养，趴在柜台边看锻打的火花
promptProse: At the smithy counter, Cartethyia has laid her sheathed sword on a padded cloth for maintenance. She rests her forearms on the counter and watches sparks rise from the distant forge where the smith works beyond the edge of the frame, blue eyes brightening as she talks about the feel of her blade. Her cream high-collared tunic, blue travel jacket and practical trousers retain the unassuming appearance of a wandering knight. Warm forge light reaches her blonde braid and the counter; the sparks stay around the far anvil, beyond her reach.
